title: Commit the work in a git repository (git writes only inside the project)
prompt: This folder is a git repository with changes that are not committed. Commit all of them in one commit with the message "add notes and config".
check: test "$(git log --format=%s | head -1)" = "add notes and config" && test "$(git log --oneline | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 2 && test "$(git show --name-only --format= HEAD | grep -c -e notes.txt -e config.ini)" = 2
setup: git config user.email bench@example.com && git config user.name bench && printf 'notes\n' > notes.txt && printf 'a=1\n' > config.ini
